THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT(Agreement") made as of the 21$ day of November, 2013 by 5745 LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, with an office at c/o Extell Development Company, 805 Third Avenue, 7'h Floor, New York, NY 10022 ("Current Owner"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Current Owner is the owner of certain land,with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by street address 574 Fifth Avenue, New York, New York, designated as Tax Lot 39 in Block 1262 on the Tax Map of the City of New York (the “Tax Map") and more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the “Owner Fee Parcel"); WHEREAS,Current Ownerintends to subdivide the OwnerFeeParcel to create the Owner Land (as hereinafter defined) and the Airspace Premises (as hereinafter defined); WHEREAS, Current Owner, in its capacity as owner of the lower portion of Tax Lot 39, intends to convey certain land which lies below the Cantilever Lower Limiting Plane (as hereinafter defined), with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by street address 574 Fifth Avenue, New York, New York, currently designated as part of Tax Lot 39 in Block 1262 on the Tax Map and more particularly described on Exhibit B-1 annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being          ,    "Existing Owner Building,”and the Owner Land,theExisting Owner Building and the Owner Building (as hereinafter defined) being herein collectively called the “Owner Premises"), by the OwnerPremises; WHEREAS, Current Owner, in its capacity as owner of the upper portion of Tax Lot 39 (in such capacity, sometimes referred to herein as “Developer") intends to retain that certain parcel of air space (the “Airspace Premises") which lies above a horizontal plane (the "Cantilever Lower Limiting Plane") drawn at a height of one hundred eighty (180) feet above Datum Level (as hereinafter defined), currently designated as part of Tax Lot 39 in Block 1262 on the Tax Map, as more particularly described on Exhibit B-2 annexed hereto and made a part hereof, together with certain Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined). WHEREAS, Current Owner intends that the Lower Premises Deed shall be subject to the provisions of this Agreement; WHEREAS, by execution of a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions of even date and contemporaneously herewith(the“Declaration"),Current Owner has confirmed that the Owner Land and the Airspace Premises continue to be a single and separate zoning lot, which enlarged, the “Combined Zoning Lot"), for the purpose of making available the Subject Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) for utilization in connection with the construction of one or moreNewDeveloperBuildings (as hereinafter defined); 1
